description: This file defines the 'textarea' dialog plugin for CKEditor, specifying its UI elements, behavior on show and OK actions, and handling of textarea element attributes.

methods.name: onShow
methods.description: Prepares the dialog by selecting the existing textarea element when the dialog is shown.

methods.name: onOk
methods.description: Creates or updates the textarea element with current dialog values when the OK button is pressed.

methods.name: setupContent
methods.description: Sets up dialog fields based on the selected textarea element attributes.

methods.name: commitContent
methods.description: Applies the dialog input values to the textarea element attributes.
